entries.surface: gh plate context, plate_contexts/plate_context MCP tools, docs/wiki/Agent-Context-Map.md
entries.migration_impact: Downstream PLATE surfaces can point to gh plate context list/show and the context-map wiki page as the default discovery front door. This reduces duplicated routing guidance in prompt files and makes source-of-truth lookup more direct.
entries.agent_notes: When the task is to figure out where authoritative truth lives, start with the context map rather than scanning AGENTS.md, prompt entrypoints, and deep docs in parallel.
migration_guidance: 1. Update thin prompt surfaces to point to gh plate context list/show or the matching MCP tools instead of carrying their own routing tables.
2. Keep docs/wiki/Agent-Context-Map.md aligned with the runtime context-map model.
3. Use the concern ids from the context map in future delegation and discovery features.

entries.surface: plate_delegate_to_agent, gh plate agents delegate, delegation packet contract
entries.migration_impact: Consumers of plate_delegate_to_agent can use the new packet fields instead of parsing the rendered prompt. The prompt itself is shorter and now points back to the canonical context map for extra discovery.
entries.agent_notes: Treat task/artifacts/retrieval_hints/constraints as the primary delegation contract. Use the rendered prompt only for text-only handoff surfaces.
migration_guidance: 1. Prefer the structured delegation packet fields over parsing delegation_prompt.
2. If extra context is needed during delegated work, follow gh plate context show delegation rather than copying broad repository instructions.
3. Keep future delegation extensions additive so existing CLI and MCP consumers remain compatible.

entries.migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repositories that copy these instruction surfaces will get shorter, routing-oriented prompts. Agents should consult AGENTS.md, SPEC.md, .agentic/releases/, and gh plate release status via the quick-routing table instead of relying on large duplicated prose blocks.
entries.agent_notes: Prefer the quick-routing table for first-step discovery. Treat AGENTS.md as the full process contract, SPEC.md as intent, .agentic/releases/ as implemented evidence, and gh plate release status as the default release-targeting lookup before opening PRs.
migration_guidance: 1. Update .github/copilot-instructions.md and any equivalent template-owned instruction surface from the release that contains this fragment.
2. Keep local prompt surfaces thin: surface-specific behavior plus routing cues only.
3. If you maintain custom agents, point them to authoritative artifacts and live discovery commands instead of copying large process summaries.
